Cannot affect organic matter, and if he tries, he gets harmed by harmful energy feedback | An agitated state will increase the chances of triggering a New Big Bang Notable Attacks/Techniques * Molecular Reconstruction: Firestorm has one main ability which all other stem from. Firestorm can break down and reapply subatomic particles as well as break up the molecular structure of elements and rearrange them. To do this the element must know the exact elemental make-up of the object or human. Most Firestorms cannot affect living tissue but it is possible though very unstable. * Density Control: Firestorm has complete control over molecules and as such can change the density of solids, liquids and gases to as light as hydrogen or as heavy as uranium. Although he has direct control over an object's density he can use this ability on himself and only himself and affect living tissue to pass through objects. * Matrix Memory Recall: Elements tied to the Firestorm Matrix can access the memories of each and every single being that has ever been fused into the Matrix. New elements are allowed to automatically download surface information. *Energy Manipulation: **Energy Projection: Firestorm can project massive amounts of different amount of energies. Naturally occurring energy projected by Firestorm are "Nuclear Blasts" however elements can project a number of different energies at will, such as Kryptonite energy. **Energy Absorption: Firestorm can absorb massive amounts of energy as well as being able to absorb many different types of energy. Most commonly the elements and energies associate with life and the human body are absorbed. **Forcefield Creation: Firestorm can create energy shields and energy forcefields to deflect and stop attacks, like energy beams and punches *Quark Vision: The ability to see extremely small objects and images down to the subatomic level. *Self-Sustenance: Elements tied to the Firestorm Matrix can survive in space unaided, never need to eat to sustain life and never truly need another element to be processed or broken down by their bodies. Notes: *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. *At emotional equilibrium, the chances of a Big Bang are near zero.
